segments.he: אָמַר רַב יְהוּדָה: כְּשׁוּת וַחֲזִיז – אֵין בָּהֶם מִשּׁוּם גָּזֵל. בְּאַתְרָא דְּקָפְדִי – יֵשׁ בָּהֶן מִשּׁוּם גָּזֵל. אָמַר רָבִינָא: וּמָתָא מַחְסֵיָא – אַתְרָא דְּקָפְדִי הוּא.
segments.en: «Rav Yehuda says: Dodder [keshut] and green grain [veḥaziz], are not subject to» the prohibition against «robbery,» as they grow on their own and no one tends to them. But «in a place where» people «are particular» about the ownership of dodder and green grain, «they are subject to» the prohibition against «robbery. Ravina said: And the city» of «Meḥasya is a city where» the residents «are particular» about dodder and green wheat.
